name: codex-delegate
tagline_zh: 把活丢给 Codex 当后台苦力，自己只当审查官。改完看 diff，满意再合入——别亲手写，别盯屏，别被细节淹没。
tagline_en: Hand the coding to Codex in the background, then review the diff and merge. You stay the reviewer, not the typist.
desc_en: Delegate a coding task to the OpenAI Codex CLI as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to hand implementation work to Codex — phrasings like "have Codex do X", "delegate this to Codex", "run it through Codex", or "use Codex to implement/fix/refactor" — or to run a queue of coding tasks through Codex while staying the reviewer. Prefer
why_zh: 同类工具只帮你生成代码，它却让你保持审查者身份——任务排队、后台执行、diff 复核，一条龙不抢方向盘。
why_en: Unlike tools that just generate code, this keeps you as reviewer—queue tasks, run in background, review diffs, stay in control.
